company.name: Collective Health
company.shortDescription: Collective Health is a modern TPA integrating plan admin, navigation and advocacy to deliver a better health benefits experience for all.
company.description:
Collective Health is the leading independent third party administrator (TPA) that brings together plan administration, cost management, and taking great care of your people—all in one place. Conventional wisdom in health benefits says you must choose: better or safe. Collective Health allows you to have both.

For self-funded employers, Collective Health provides a unified foundation with Collective TPA™, My Collective®, Care Navigation, Collective Compass®, and Partner Collective®—combining technology, clinical expertise, and a flexible partner ecosystem to simplify administration, improve decision-making, and guide members through their healthcare journeys.

Founded in 2013, Collective Health serves more than 800,000 members from organizations including Red Bull, The Wonderful Company, Boot Barn, Live Nation, Driscoll’s, Uber, and Zoom. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with additional locations in Plano, Texas, and Lehi, Utah.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series F round raised $280,000,000, or 38.62% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $28,111,814 to $1,500,000,000, a 53.36x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 47 (-6 over 90 days) and market heat at 33 (-13).
